name: Biel Sardà
biography:
I’m Biel. I help shape BrainiLab’s games, articles and Academy courses, from choosing topics to making the website clearer and easier to use. I like a question that makes you pause, try something and discover why the answer works.

I work as an audiovisual producer on events worldwide, and I studied psychology at the University of Vic – Central University of Catalonia. At BrainiLab, I bring those interests into short challenges and practical lessons that you can explore at your own pace.
